selection: First8 exact relation-template matches per edited case from source indices >=128, excluding the edited subject and gold equal to the new target; no output filtering. Indices16..127 remain reserved.
status: Prospective scope bank; no GPU worker submitted
scope: Two exposed edits,16 new off-subject prompts; diagnostic, not fresh method confirmation
hypothesis: Good unrelated utility can conceal relation-wide target leakage. Actual-gradient selection may learn a generic relation answer rather than binding the fact to the intended subject; cross-prompt agreement alone does not prevent this.
intervention: Use every frozen v1 patch at saved strength; no training, selection or scaling changes
metrics: Reference-prefix retention conditional on baseline reference matches; exact continuation agreement; new-target prefix leakage separately even where baseline answers are wrong. Inspect full outputs. Source answers are benchmark references, not independently verified current facts.
conditions: Base and all five v1 conditions for each case; no post-hoc best-only comparison
cold_load: Verify all artifact delta tensors; reproduce fixed saved generated sequences before new probes
execution_decision: Review the complete v1 pilot first. Launch no overlapping GPU worker. Run only if at least one actual-gradient variant has both original edit prefixes,>=3/6 untrained-wording hits,more than augmented FiNE, at least8/32 baseline utility matches and no more than2 total lost baseline-correct global-utility probes across both edits. Otherwise report why a scope run is not informative yet.
limitations: Small, exact-template bank; no assertion of semantic scope robustness, answer accuracy or superiority from leakage/retention alone.
